The '''''Resilient''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that took part in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. It was among the vessels that joined with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] and accepted [[Kral Nevil]] after he defected to Niathal's [[Alliance-in-exile]].
